title: Cloud Rap
tagline: Drift, haze and space around the beat instead of high-definition punch.
summary: Cloud rap emphasizes atmosphere, floating vocal textures and a softer approach to rhythm than classic boom-bap. It often blends melodic singing, looser tempos and digital production textures with rap delivery. The result feels airy and suspended, more tactile than rigid.

pillars.name: Lil Wayne
pillars.why: Lil Wayne helped bring the style into wider rap culture with melodic flow and a relaxed rhythmic approach.

pillars.name: Young Thug
pillars.why: Young Thug made melodic drift and vocal texture central to the form.

pillars.name: A$AP Rocky
pillars.why: A$AP Rocky balanced floating production with sharp rap timing and a more polished visual identity.
